parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- true: enables auto-renewal.
- false (default): disables auto-renewal.

parameters.name: AutoRenewPeriod
parameters.description:
The auto-renewal period, in months. This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to True.

<props="china">Valid values of AutoRenewPeriod: 1, 12, 36, and 60.</props>

<props="china">If PeriodUnit is set to Month, the default value is 1.</props>

<props="intl">Valid values of AutoRenewPeriod: 12 and 36.</props>

If PeriodUnit is set to Year, the default value is 12.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the reserved instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

Default value: empty.

parameters.name: InstanceAmount
parameters.description:
The number of pay-as-you-go instances of the same instance type that the reserved instance can match at the same time. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type that the reserved instance can match.

> Applicable instance types are continuously updated. For more information, see [Overview of reserved instances](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~).

parameters.name: OfferingType
parameters.description:
The payment type of the reserved instance. Valid values: 
         
- No Upfront: no upfront.
- Partial Upfront: partial upfront.
- All Upfront: all upfront.

Default value: All Upfront.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The term of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: 1 and 3.</props>


<props="china">

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values are 1, 3, and 5.

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, the valid value is 1.

</props>


Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the term of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: Year.</props>

<props="intl">Default value: Year.</props>

<props="china">Valid values: Year and Month.</props>

<props="china">Default value: Month.</props>

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system type of the image used by the instance. Valid values:

- Windows: Windows Server operating system.
- Linux: Linux and Unix-like operating system.

Default value: Linux.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the reserved instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values: 
   
- Region: regional. 
- Zone: zonal.

Default value: Region.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The effective period of the reserved instance. The time follows the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in UTC+0. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHHZ`.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the effective period starts from the nearest time frame by default. For example, if you successfully purchase a reserved instance at 2024-11-01 13:45:35, the effective period starts at 2024-11-01 13:00:00.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the reserved instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the reserved instance. The tag value cannot be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. This parameter is required and takes effect only when `Scope` is set to `Zone`. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the zone list.
